page_title.en: Lily's Ten Stones — Make a Ten to Add & Subtract

page_intro.en: Help Lily the frog cross the pond on the number line: to add or subtract past ten, first hop to the golden Ten Stone, then the rest. Build the make-a-ten part yourself — 8 + 2 makes 10, then 10 + 4 is 14. A strategy game, not a speed drill. Common Core 1.OA.C.6.

rounds.prompt: 8 + 6. Hop to the Ten Stone first: 8 + ⬚ = 10.
7 + 5. Make a ten: 7 + ⬚ = 10, then hop the rest.
6 + 3. Will Lily need to rest on the Ten Stone?
13 − 4. Hop back to the Ten Stone: 13 − ⬚ = 10.
3 + 8. Which number should Lily stand on to reach ten quickest?
8 + 6. Will Lily need to rest on the Ten Stone?
7 + 8. Which DOUBLE is just one away from helping?
9 + 4. Make a ten: 9 + ⬚ = 10, then hop the rest.
15 − 7. Hop back to the Ten Stone: 15 − ⬚ = 10.
9 + 2. Which number should Lily stand on to reach ten quickest?
8 + 6 = 14. Watch it hop backward: 14 − 6 = 8. Same stones!
